'''Vyord Yanol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He also served as one of the main advisors of [[Dark Council]]or and head of the [[Sphere of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Darth Jadus]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was the last person see Jadus alive before the explosion of the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']] but immediately after, he resigned from [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and fled to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. When [[Cipher Nine]] found him Vyord tried to kill them, but was killed himself.
